snapshot.scope_description: Sentry self-hosted docker-compose deployment with the feature-complete profile: ingest edge, app and task system, ingest consumers, Snuba and data stores.
omissions: Install scripts, one-shot init containers, optional-modification overrides and test services are not modeled.
Individual Kafka topics and ClickHouse tables are not modeled; consumer-to-topic mappings are summarised as reads and writes on Kafka.
Topic interfaces are modeled only where Taskbroker's config names them; all other Kafka use goes to the broker. Which topic each consumer reads was not traced.
Postgres access from sentry-cleanup is modeled; per-task behaviour inside task workers is not.
